name: Tag
summary: Compact, often-closable chip for categorizing or filtering. Distinct from Badge (status / count, sm-only, never closable) and TagsInput (a multi-value form control composed of Tags). Five tones map to a soft tinted bg + matching fg; the operator-default 'subtle' tone is a hairline-bordered pill on canvas. Optional leading icon, optional trailing dismiss.

tone.description: subtle: hairline pill — quiet category chip (default). neutral: filled neutral chip. accent: text.accent on tint-accent. info/success/warning/danger: status tint.

size.description: sm=22 px (operator/table chip). md=28 px (interactive filter chip).

dismissible.description: Renders a trailing × icon-button. Fires onDismiss when activated; the tag remains in DOM until removed by the consumer.

selected.description: When true, renders the action.selected.* tokens — used for filter chips toggled on/off (FilterBar pattern).

onClick.description: When provided, the tag becomes a button (role='button', focusable, Enter/Space activates). Use for filter chips. Don't combine with dismissible — use IconButton-as-button inside.

keyboard: Tab - move focus to interactive tag
Enter / Space - activate onClick OR toggle selected
Backspace - dismiss the focused tag (when dismissible)
Tab - move focus past the dismiss button
rules: Interactive tags (onClick / asLink) carry role='button' or render <a>. Static tags carry no role.
selected tags set aria-pressed='true' so SR users hear the toggle state.
Color is never the only signal: tone reinforces a label the user can read.

do: Use subtle tone as the default — a Tag should not compete with a Button on chrome weight.
Use accent tone for primary filter chips that are selected.
Pair with TagsInput when the chip is part of a multi-value form control.
Lead with the value, not the category — 'San Francisco', not 'City: San Francisco'.
Cap label width at ~24ch; longer values truncate with ellipsis + Tooltip.
dont: Don't use a Tag as a primary CTA. Use Button.
Don't use solid lime fill on a Tag. action.selected (~12% tint) is the selection tint.
Don't render 8+ Tags in a row — collapse with 'and N more'.
Don't pack interactive AND dismissible — that's two affordances on one chip.

changelog.note: Initial Tag contract. Seven tones, two sizes, dismiss + selected + onClick / asLink variants. Distinct from Badge (status pill).
